{"id": 1, "question": "How do I add a new supplier in VendorIQ?", "answer": "Open Suppliers, select Add supplier, enter the required company and contact details, then save the record.", "category": "suppliers", "is_active": true, "display_order": 1}

{"id": 2, "question": "How can I update a supplier contact?", "answer": "Open the supplier profile, choose Edit, update the contact fields, and save your changes.", "category": "inventory", "is_active": true, "display_order": 2}

{"id": 3, "question": "Where can I review supplier details?", "answer": "Use the Suppliers workspace to search by supplier name, status, or contact information.", "category": "warehousing", "is_active": true, "display_order": 3}

{"id": 4, "question": "How do I create an inventory item?", "answer": "Open Inventory, select Add item, provide the SKU and warehouse details, and save the item.", "category": "reporting", "is_active": true, "display_order": 4}

{"id": 5, "question": "How can I adjust an item's reorder threshold?", "answer": "Edit the inventory item and update its reorder threshold. The new value is used for future alert checks.", "category": "administration", "is_active": true, "display_order": 5}

{"id": 6, "question": "Where can I view current stock levels?", "answer": "Open Inventory and filter by warehouse, SKU, or stock status to review current quantities.", "category": "suppliers", "is_active": true, "display_order": 6}

{"id": 7, "question": "How do I find items below their reorder point?", "answer": "Apply the Below reorder point filter in Inventory to identify items that may need replenishment.", "category": "inventory", "is_active": true, "display_order": 7}

{"id": 8, "question": "How can I review warehouse inventory?", "answer": "Open Warehouses, select a location, and review its item quantities and stock status.", "category": "warehousing", "is_active": true, "display_order": 8}

{"id": 9, "question": "How do I record an inbound shipment?", "answer": "Open Shipments, select Create shipment, enter the shipment details, and associate the relevant order.", "category": "reporting", "is_active": false, "display_order": 9}

{"id": 10, "question": "Where can I track shipment status?", "answer": "Use the Shipments workspace to search by tracking number, supplier, warehouse, or current status.", "category": "administration", "is_active": true, "display_order": 10}

{"id": 11, "question": "How do I create a purchase order?", "answer": "Open Purchase Orders, select Create order, add the required items, and submit the order for processing.", "category": "suppliers", "is_active": true, "display_order": 11}

{"id": 12, "question": "How can I review open purchase orders?", "answer": "Filter Purchase Orders by Open status to review orders that still require fulfillment or receipt.", "category": "inventory", "is_active": true, "display_order": 12}

{"id": 13, "question": "How do I configure a low-stock alert?", "answer": "Open Alerting, create a rule for stock levels, and select the warehouses or items it should monitor.", "category": "warehousing", "is_active": true, "display_order": 13}

{"id": 14, "question": "How can I change alert recipients?", "answer": "Edit the alert rule and update its recipients before saving the configuration.", "category": "reporting", "is_active": true, "display_order": 14}

{"id": 15, "question": "Where can I review recent platform alerts?", "answer": "Open the Alerts view and filter by severity, category, or date to review recent notifications.", "category": "administration", "is_active": true, "display_order": 15}

{"id": 16, "question": "How do I build an inventory report?", "answer": "Open Reports, choose the inventory report template, set filters, and run the report.", "category": "suppliers", "is_active": true, "display_order": 16}

{"id": 17, "question": "How can I schedule a recurring report?", "answer": "Save the report configuration and choose a schedule under Report settings.", "category": "inventory", "is_active": true, "display_order": 17}

{"id": 18, "question": "Where can I download a completed report?", "answer": "Open Reports, select the completed report, and use Download to export the available file.", "category": "warehousing", "is_active": true, "display_order": 18}

{"id": 19, "question": "How do I filter analytics by warehouse?", "answer": "Open Analytics, select Warehouse as the grouping, and apply the required date and supplier filters.", "category": "reporting", "is_active": true, "display_order": 19}

{"id": 20, "question": "How can I compare inventory across suppliers?", "answer": "Use the supplier and warehouse filters together in Analytics to compare inventory positions.", "category": "administration", "is_active": false, "display_order": 20}

{"id": 21, "question": "What should I do if dashboard data looks stale?", "answer": "Check the report refresh time, confirm source records are current, and contact support if the issue persists.", "category": "suppliers", "is_active": true, "display_order": 21}

{"id": 22, "question": "How do I manage user access?", "answer": "Administrators can open Administration and assign the appropriate role from the user's access settings.", "category": "inventory", "is_active": true, "display_order": 22}

{"id": 23, "question": "How can I deactivate a platform user?", "answer": "Open the user's administration profile, choose Deactivate, and confirm the change.", "category": "warehousing", "is_active": true, "display_order": 23}

{"id": 24, "question": "Where can I update notification preferences?", "answer": "Open your profile settings and update the notification channels and alert preferences.", "category": "reporting", "is_active": true, "display_order": 24}

{"id": 25, "question": "How do I contact platform support?", "answer": "Open Platform Support and submit a concise description with the affected record or report details.", "category": "administration", "is_active": true, "display_order": 25}
